use default

let witnesses = [2n, 3n, 5n, 7n, 11n, 13n, 17n, 19n, 23n, 29n, 31n, 37n]

passes(witness: bigint, odd_part: bigint, power: int,
       value: bigint) -> bool is
    let residue mut = bigint.mod_pow(witness, odd_part, value)

    if residue =~ 1n \/ residue =~ value - 1n then return true fi

    for _ in 1..power do
        residue = residue * residue % value

        if residue =~ value - 1n then return true fi
    od

    false
si

is_prime(value: bigint) -> bool is
    if value < 2n then return false fi

    for witness in witnesses do
        if value =~ witness then return true fi
        if value % witness =~ 0n then return false fi
    od

    let odd_part mut = value - 1n
    let power mut = 0

    while odd_part % 2n =~ 0n do
        odd_part = odd_part / 2n
        power = power + 1
    od

    witnesses |> all(witness => passes(witness, odd_part, power, value))
si

three_smooth() -> Pipe[bigint] is
    let found = LIST[bigint]()
    let next_double mut = 0
    let next_triple mut = 0
    let value mut = 1n

    do
        found.add(value)

        yield value

        let doubled = found[next_double] * 2n
        let tripled = found[next_triple] * 3n

        value = if doubled < tripled then doubled else tripled fi

        if doubled =~ value then next_double = next_double + 1 fi
        if tripled =~ value then next_triple = next_triple + 1 fi
    od
si

pierpont(offset: bigint) -> Pipe[bigint] =>
    three_smooth() |> map(smooth => smooth + offset) |> filter(is_prime)

report(kind: string, offset: bigint) is
    let found = pierpont(offset) |> take(250) |> collect()

    write_line("first 50 Pierpont primes of the {kind} kind:")

    found
        |> take(50)
        |> chunk(10)
        |> each(row =>
            write_line(row |> map(prime => "{prime,9}") |> join("")))

    write_line("250th: {found[249]}")
    write_line()
si

report("first", 1n)
report("second", -1n)
